verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine and API server, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no official MCP server. Tool-calling support, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and an OpenAPI schema are adjacent features and do not count as an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
